filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Wed Nov 25 (after the morning run) – Thu Nov 26 morning PT (US Thanksgiving; items already on the Nov 25 and earlier briefs not re-led)

market_briefing.lede: Sales work is moving into the AI assistant and starting to write back to the CRM from there, while the assistant vendors change how that work is metered and protected.

bullets.text: Nov 25: Salesforce said the Salesforce in Claude plugin ships 37 prebuilt sales skills (meeting prep, deal health, pipeline reviews). BACA Systems says over half its employees use it; at Legora, record creates, updates and deletes are almost 20% of its headless tool-call volume.

Nov 25: OpenAI began moving ChatGPT's Chat and Work to one shared usage meter for a small group of Pro users, with a wider rollout in December; OpenAI says a small share of its heaviest users may hit limits sooner, and Instant stays unlimited.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI pilots Private Inference for business prompts
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 25: an alpha in OpenAI's Private Intelligence package that uses confidential computing to keep prompts and replies private while they are processed; a small group of customers, no date for a wider rollout.

biggest_ai_news.title: Claude agents moved Anthropic's Messages API to Rust
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 25: Anthropic says the rewrite cut CPU per request about 70% and median time to first token about 20%, with no downtime; agents found and fixed mismatches against live traffic under human review.

biggest_ai_news.title: Amazon and Meta discuss ending the Muse blockade
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 25: Fortune reports talks to let Meta's Muse agent shop on Amazon, with search results and advertising the open issues; no deal, and both companies declined to comment.

what_changed.title: Salesforce publishes early results from Salesforce in Claude
what_changed.body: Nov 25: a Salesforce blog says the plugin (part of Claudeforce, launched at Dreamforce) comes with 37 prebuilt sales skills, and that customers can build custom skills on Salesforce's MCP server. BACA Systems says over half its employees use it; Legora says writes (create, update, delete) are almost 20% of its headless tool-call volume; Deloitte is exploring it for opportunity management.

what_changed.title: Benioff posts Salesforce's Cyber Week day-one numbers
what_changed.body: Nov 25: Marc Benioff posted 5.57M agent conversations and actions, 2.8 trillion Zero Copy data rows accessed (+1,237% year over year), 6.9B messages delivered and $554M in Commerce GMV for day one of Cyber Week (company-reported).

what_changed.title: ChatGPT moves Chat and Work to one usage meter
what_changed.body: Nov 25: rollout started for a small group of Pro users; broader rollout planned for December. Instant chats stay unlimited and do not count toward the shared allowance.

what_changed.title: OpenAI starts testing Private Inference
what_changed.body: Nov 25: Sam Altman announced the alpha with a small group of customers; it joins Private Safety Processing (rolling out since September) in Private Intelligence.

quiet_note: No launch, funding, M&A or pricing change from Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft or Monaco dated Nov 25–26 (US Thanksgiving). Clay's posts were GTM-engineer content and a guide; Gong's LinkedIn post was a GTA 6 joke; Monaco's X activity was retweets (a customer's MCP testimonial and a podcast clip of Sam Blond citing ~$40k ACVs with $10k of credit up front; the up-front credit is already on Monaco's pricing page).

market_direction.label: Accelerating (CRM work from inside the assistant)
market_direction.text: Salesforce in Claude pilots report 37 prebuilt skills and writes at almost 20% of one customer's tool calls (Nov 25), a day after Skills over MCP (Nov 24).

market_direction.label: New (one meter for chat and agent work)
market_direction.text: OpenAI is pooling Chat and Work usage into a single ChatGPT allowance (Nov 25), so heavier agentic work draws down the same budget.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (provider-side privacy controls)
market_direction.text: OpenAI's Private Inference pilot (Nov 25) follows Bedrock's customer-held retention for Anthropic models (Nov 23).

market_direction.label: Steady (Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft, Monaco)
market_direction.text: No announcements of their own Nov 25–26 over Thanksgiving.

language_pulse.gloss: Legora's phrase for Salesforce actions run from Claude rather than the Salesforce UI (Nov 25).
OpenAI's alpha that keeps business prompts and replies private during processing via confidential computing (Nov 25).
OpenAI's single ChatGPT allowance across Chat and Work (Nov 25).

competitive_moves.text: Salesforce in Claude pilot results: 37 prebuilt sales skills, over half of BACA Systems' staff using it, writes at almost 20% of Legora's headless tool calls (Nov 25); Benioff posted 5.57M agent conversations and actions on Cyber Week day one (Nov 25).

watch.title: Wed Dec 2: Salesforce Q3 FY27 results
watch.body: Results after the close, call 2:00 PM PT. Watch for full Cyber Week agent numbers after Benioff's day-one post, plus any adoption figures for Salesforce in Claude and Coworker in the SMB suites.

interpretation.fact: Nov 25 Salesforce published Salesforce in Claude pilot results (37 prebuilt sales skills; BACA Systems over half of staff; Legora writes at almost 20% of headless tool calls), and Benioff posted Cyber Week day-one platform numbers. Nov 25 OpenAI began rolling out a shared Chat and Work usage meter and started testing Private Inference; Anthropic described its agent-built Rust migration of the Messages API; Fortune reported Amazon–Meta talks on Muse. Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach, Salesloft and Monaco announced nothing new of their own Nov 25–26.
interpretation.interpretation: Writes, not lookups, are the sign that the assistant is becoming the place where CRM work happens; once that holds, the questions buyers ask shift to who meters the work and who can see the data, which is where OpenAI moved this week.

feed.summary: Marc Benioff posted Salesforce's Cyber Week day-one numbers: 5.57M agent conversations and actions, 2.8 trillion Zero Copy rows accessed, 6.9B messages and $554M in Commerce GMV.
